constraints: Every claim and disagreement must have an evidence_path citation (file:line, $defs name, or doc#section). The schema enforces this.
Do not propose features that already exist — read the code first. Examples that exist: TaskFamily registry, grounded schemas, alias resolution, schema-smoke integration tests.
Disagree explicitly when you disagree. Politeness that hides disagreement defeats the deliberation.
If you cite agreed_with_peer, do so by the peer's actual claim_id. Don't fabricate.
question: The duet (asymmetric implementer+reviewer, 1 revise cycle) and deliberation (symmetric N-agent debate, multi-round, convergence-driven) sibling workflows just shipped on aisteno/llm_client (commit 4d3e5ce on main). Five dogfood-on-self loops caught real bugs during build (claude-code/opus routing, codex cwd, CLI threading, missing rubric rule, OpenAI strict-mode), and the schema-smoke integration tests verify strict-mode works live. This is the first real-task deliberation — your job is to scrutinize the SHIPPED design and surface the highest-leverage improvement we're missing. Specifically argue about: (1) is the rule-based convergence detector (disagreed_with_peer empty + agreed_with_peer covers peer claim IDs) trustworthy, or does it false-converge on polite-agent behavior? (2) does the schema's required evidence_path actually make findings falsifiable, or do agents game it with bogus citations? (3) does two-agent topology miss blind spots that three-agent would catch? (4) what fails first at max_rounds > 5 (context bloat? non-cumulative budget? convergence drift?) and is fixing that the right next priority, or is something else higher-leverage? (5) is asymmetric duet + symmetric deliberation the right partition, or do we need a third pattern? Cite duet.py / deliberate.py / duet_base.py / duet_registry.py / profiles/* / cli/duet.py / cli/deliberate.py / tests/test_workflow_schema_smoke.py line ranges. Disagree explicitly. The single highest-priority next improvement is the deliverable.
success_criteria: Each agent identifies at least three structural weaknesses with file:line citations.
Each agent ranks the weaknesses by leverage and defends the ranking.
Residual disagreements over the ranking are explicit, not papered over by the synthesis.
The synthesis names the single highest-priority improvement with a one-paragraph justification.
title: Self-deliberation: what's structurally wrong with the duet + deliberation chassis?
